name: Commerce Paymob
description: Drupal Commerce payment gateway for Paymob, with offsite Redirect and onsite Pixel flows and HMAC-verified callbacks.
project_description:
Commerce Paymob module implements the Paymob payment processing service (Paymob) in Drupal Commerce.

 This module supports redirect and pixel (iframe) methods.

 Installtion instructions: 
 * You can install this module via Composer (recommended), or

* clone it from drupal.org Git repo, or

* Download the module from drupal.org

 Version 2.0.x from this module is developed & sponsored by Coders Enterprise Web & Mobile Solutions
